name: Minamoto no Yoritomo
source:
He is the leader of the Minamoto clan, starting the Kamakura Shogunate and becoming the shogun.

He took you into the shogunate because you obtained the power of the fox spirit. He looks perfect, but his real personality is pushy and scheming. Some strong resolution is hidden in his two-sidedness……?

Organization: Kamakura Bakufu
Interests: Work (to the point of addiction), human observation
